caption:
Figure 4. Illustration of our DFormerv2. (a) Overall architecture of our DFormerv2, which contains an encoder with pyramid structure
and a decoder head that receives input from the last three stage features. (b) Detailed structure of the basic building block. (c) Detailed
illustration of the proposed geometry self-attention mechanism.
delegated_acceptance_review: Actually viewed the final DFormerv2 image and read its caption and eight independent checks. The four-stage pyramid encoder, last-three-stage decoder inputs, two residual block paths, and complete G/Q/K/V geometry-attention formulas and dimensions are retained. Original top architecture and basic block remain native; the full attention panel is enlarged 2x nearest-neighbor. Added numbered headers map to the original three panels, and the decoder statement is explicit in the caption. There is no new prior-input route or invented tensor relation; all three operation legend entries remain readable.
